notes.title: Happy Anniversary Mines of Volantis!
notes.content:
It's been already a year since Mines of Volantis released. How time flies...
To celebrate the one year anniversary of the release the game will be 50% off for a week!

So if you haven't gotten a chance to play it yet, this might be a good moment to give it a try!

notes.title: 1.1.0 Scanning Update
notes.content:
Hello miners! It took a while but I'm proud to give you the Scanning update! A scanner ability, analyzer building, harvester customization, minimap, a lot of new stuff! I hope you enjoy it!

Patch Notes

[b]Features:[/b]
-Added Scanner ability.
-Added Artifact analyzer building.
-Added Workshop building. Allowing you to customize your harvester!
-Added Artifacts and Harvester components that can be scanned. These will remain discovered when starting a new game.
-Added Minimap, allowing you to see scanned areas and their items.
-Added Energy Cells currency. Find these by scanning Volantis and use them to construct the beacon.
-Added Vsync to video options.
-Replaced the 'New Discovery' and 'Reward Received' popups with a scrolling text at the harvester.
-Added 4 Artifact achievements.
-In case specific resource is not obtainable anymore, you can buyout its requirement for credits at the beacon.

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
-Increased size of several layers of the map.
-Moved Ore Compressor research to Tier 2. Added Portable Refinery to Tier 3. Added Quantum Storage to Tier 4.
-Base fuel tank changes from 20L to 25L.
-Reduced Tier 3 research blocks points gain from 25 to 10. Reduced Tier 4 research cost from 500 to 200 points.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed a bug where refueling at the Fuel Station did not work when starting a new game, after completing the game.
-Tweaked some loud sounds.
-Fixed death sound not being effected by the Effects volume slider.

notes.title: Quick update on the upcoming content
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since I last gave you an update on Mines of Volantis. I am working very hard on a few new systems that will give you new ways to explore Volantis. I won't give away too much yet, but it's about scanning and analyzing artifacts hidden on the planet.

These changes will add a more interesting experience and also more replayability. This update will be FREE and is NOT a DLC.

Testing will start soon and I hope to bring these awesome features to you before the end of the year.

notes.title: Upcoming Content
notes.content:
Hello Miners!

It's already been 4 days since Mines of Volantis released and it's been quite a ride. We're very happy to hear that you enjoyed the game, but you're left with a feeling of wanting more, a lot more.

That's why we will be working on bringing new content to the game so you can get back to mining and unlocking more cool stuff! This content will be a FREE update! So don't miss it when it comes out!

We will be giving updates on development progress and we hope you'll get excited about the upcoming changes!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: One of the issues that prevented players from properly playing Mines of Volantis, was the ability to set the resolution and windowed mode. A video options menu has been added with patch 1.0.1 allowing you to do so.

notes.title: Mines of Volantis now available on Steam!
notes.content: Mines of Volantis is now available to play on Steam! Get ready to take control of your harvester and dig through the ground to discover resources, to buy upgrades and all kinds of research! Can you build the communication beacon to call for help and escape Volantis?

notes.title: Mines of Volantis Coming September 1st!
notes.content:
After three years of development, Mines of Volantis will be available on September 1st! [b]Wishlist now[/b] to be notified on release day and start mining immediately!

*Procedural world: The world is uniquely generated each time. You will never know what resources and artifacts you will find next time!

*Collect: Find valuable resources to sell them and to refuel your harvester.

*Upgrades: To achieve greater depths, upgrade to a bigger fuel tank, or maybe a bigger cargo bay? The choice is yours.

*Research: Unlock new technology like advanced thrusters and the personal teleporter!

*Escape: Construct an emergency communication beacon to send out a call for help.
